what: `blaze doc` on v2: the v1 entry dispatched `blaze doc` to crates/blaze-doc (rustdoc replacement, no-rustc); integrate-engine deleted that entry (blaze-engine/src/doc.rs) and v2 `blaze_cargo::cli` has only build/check/run/test/bench (blaze_units::query::Command). Add `Command::Doc` (cargo doc's flags, clap text as for the others) whose daemon side lowers the units through blaze-lower and calls blaze-doc on the `base_db::Db`, writing cargo's target/doc layout. Without it `cargo doc` stops working under blaze, a regression (superset-of-rust). blaze-doc's manifest already takes base-db/hir directly (ide-db gone). Tell integrate when done.

history.note: Already in v2: blaze_units::query::Command::Doc with cargo doc's flags (cli/args.rs), Request::Doc { view, targets, no_deps, private } (cli.rs request), Work::Doc in serve/job.rs, and serve/unit.rs:871 `doc` lowering the units and calling blaze-doc on the Db, writing target/doc; serve/tests.rs covers Request::Doc. integrate: nothing to do.
